## Install
Download **D-Patch-{{VERSION}}.dmg** below, open it and drag **D-Patch** onto **Applications** (replace the old copy; your scan results and settings are kept). Requires macOS 14 or later on a Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or later); Intel Macs aren't supported.

The app is signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple. The first time you open it, macOS asks to confirm that you want to open an app downloaded from the internet.

If you use Automatic scan, open the new copy from Applications once so the schedule points at it.

SHA-256: `{{SHA256}}`
